title: Multiplicity and sequential release decisions
outcome: Prespecify a family of comparisons and monitoring times, calculate conservative error control, and separate statistical evidence from release policy.

exercises.title: One comparison
exercises.task: Test one valid p-value 0.05 at alpha 0.05.
exercises.answer: With one prespecified comparison the threshold remains 0.05; this code uses <=.

exercises.title: Three equal findings
exercises.answer: Three nominal findings are not three adjusted findings under this family definition.

exercises.title: Overspend the budget
exercises.task: Allocate 0.03 and 0.03 while total alpha is 0.05.
exercises.answer: The advertised family bound requires the total allocation to remain within its declared budget.

exercises.title: Specify dependent looks
exercises.task: Explain whether the union bound requires independent tests.
exercises.expected: It does not; individual error bounds still need to hold.
exercises.hint: Separate the bound from the illustrative independent calculation.
exercises.answer: The formula 1-(1-alpha)^m uses independence; the union-bound inequality does not.

exercises.title: Unknown result
exercises.hint: Do not silently drop the row and reduce the family.
exercises.answer: Unknown evidence requires an explicit incomplete assessment, not a smaller multiplicity correction.

exercises.title: Separate value from significance
exercises.task: A precise improvement is below the minimum useful effect.
exercises.expected: The statistical result alone does not mandate deployment.
exercises.hint: Use a declared practical margin and independent safety gates.
exercises.answer: A release decision combines expected utility, uncertainty, constraints and costs; its logic must be recorded separately from a p-value.
